description: Source code for MediaMetrics interface providing C-style functions to manage media metrics items, including creation, deletion, attribute setting/getting, and serialization.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a media metrics item, providing methods for attribute management, serialization, and duplication.

methods.name: mediametrics_create
methods.description: Creates a new media metrics item with a specified key.

methods.name: mediametrics_delete
methods.description: Deletes a media metrics item.

methods.name: mediametrics_getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key associated with a media metrics item.

methods.name: mediametrics_setUid
methods.description: Sets the UID attribute for a media metrics item.

methods.name: mediametrics_setInt32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit integer attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_setInt64
methods.description: Sets a 64-bit integer attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_setDouble
methods.description: Sets a double-precision floating point attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_setRate
methods.description: Sets a rate attribute based on count and duration.

methods.name: mediametrics_setString
methods.description: Sets a string attribute from std::string.

methods.name: mediametrics_setCString
methods.description: Sets a string attribute from C-string.

methods.name: mediametrics_addInt32
methods.description: Adds a 32-bit integer value to an attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_addInt64
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit integer value to an attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_addDouble
methods.description: Adds a double value to an attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_addRate
methods.description: Adds a rate (count/duration) to an attribute.

methods.name: mediametrics_getInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit integer attribute value.

methods.name: mediametrics_getInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit integer attribute value.

methods.name: mediametrics_getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double attribute value.

methods.name: mediametrics_getRate
methods.description: Retrieves a rate attribute value.

methods.name: mediametrics_getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string attribute as std::string.

methods.name: mediametrics_getCString
methods.description: Retrieves a string attribute as C-string.

methods.name: mediametrics_freeCString
methods.description: Frees a C-string obtained from getCString.

methods.name: mediametrics_selfRecord
methods.description: Records the current media metrics item.

methods.name: mediametrics_dup
methods.description: Duplicates a media metrics item.

methods.name: mediametrics_readable
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the item.

methods.name: mediametrics_count
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the item.

methods.name: mediametrics_isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if media metrics are enabled.

methods.name: mediametrics_getAttributes
methods.description: Serializes the item's attributes into a byte string.
